governance_decisions.statement: Validation is scoped to L02 Review pedagogy and does not create or promote HNK lexical or grammar authority.
OPI-006 learner yes/no response remains blocked; no yes/no particle, bare-predicate productivity or declarative travel syntax is canonized.
PA remains lexical 'ontem'; no generic past, temporal syntax, morphology or DID auxiliary is established.
PITSA remains controlled loanword only with atomic TS = G30; no productive borrowing grammar is established.
VANI and VANUVALI remain unresolved and excluded; WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN labels remain unchanged; G-ID remains structural authority and Candidate D non-canonical.
If approved, validate only these 22 already authored Review slots and prepare a separate L02 Chokhmah closure gate; do not seal or advance to L03 with the same approval.
